title: 聚法法律数据 MCP 配置
description: 请输入聚法智能体数据平台 API Key。该凭证仅存储在用户本机，由 WorkBuddy 在连接聚法远程 MCP 服务时注入请求头；请勿向他人泄露。
description_en: Enter your Jufa Agent Data Platform API Key. This credential is stored only on your device and injected by WorkBuddy into request headers when connecting to the remote Jufa MCP service. Do not share it with others.
